key_insight: This review maps bias in AI disease detection and highlights explainability, data diversity, and fairness-aware design as priorities for more equitable systems.
clinical_relevance: Bias in diagnostic AI may produce uneven performance across patient populations, making fairness assessment important before clinical deployment.
method: Reviewed disease-detection AI literature within a stated 2015–2026 search window.
Selected 23 articles from 64,389 records analyzed across seven digital libraries.
Categorized approaches by input data, model architecture, and algorithmic, demographic, model, or deployment bias.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a literature review of 23 selected articles but provides no quantitative estimates of diagnostic performance or bias reduction.
watch_item: The review identifies priorities rather than demonstrating that any specific mitigation strategy reliably improves fairness in clinical practice.
paper_title: Fairness or Fallacy? Mapping the Landscape of AI Bias in Disease Detection
